description: This file defines models and fetcher classes for retrieving and processing historical futures data from Deribit exchange, including query parameter validation, data transformation, and data fetching logic.

classes.name: DeribitFuturesHistoricalQueryParams
classes.description: Model for Deribit futures historical price query parameters, including symbol validation and default date range calculation.

classes.name: DeribitFuturesHistoricalData
classes.description: Data model for Deribit futures historical data, extending the standard futures historical data with volume notional.

classes.name: DeribitFuturesHistoricalFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to retrieve and process Deribit futures historical data asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms a dictionary of parameters into a DeribitFuturesHistoricalQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches OHLC data for specified symbols and query parameters, handling errors and sorting results by date.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into structured DeribitFuturesHistoricalData instances, handling single or multiple symbols.
